classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Retrieve, analyse, and rank representative sequences for NAD(P)HX repair proteins carrying ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase (GO:0102298) and NADPHX epimerase (GO:0102299) activities, using GO-term and InterPro-family pulls followed by per-set sequence analysis and aggregate ranking.
assumptions: GO:0102298 encodes ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity and GO:0102299 encodes NADPHX epimerase activity in the current GO release; both are used as default params and should be verified against the live GO ontology before execution.

IPR023691 is used as the candidate InterPro family accession for NAD(P)HX repair proteins; this must be confirmed — the correct entry may be IPR004794 (YjeF N-terminal domain) or a more specific family record.
reviewed=true restricts retrieval to Swiss-Prot curated entries, trading recall for precision; removing this filter expands the candidate pool at the cost of annotation noise.

Representative diversity is achieved via GO/InterPro pull with deduplication rather than MMseqs2 clustering because no local MMseqs2-formatted target database path is available; the reviewed-only filter provides a de-facto high-confidence representative set.
sequence_analysis runs on the full multi-sequence FASTA from each retrieval node; composition, charge, and motif profiles from these three sets feed rank_designs as analysis objects.
rank_designs receives the three retrieval outputs as candidates and the three analysis outputs as analyses; final top_k=10 returns the highest-scoring sequences across all three sources.
No structure generation, binder design, or cloud GPU inference is required for this sequence-understanding task.
missing_inputs: Verified GO accession for ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity (GO:0102298 assumed — please confirm against current GO release).
Verified GO accession for NADPHX epimerase activity (GO:0102299 assumed — please confirm against current GO release).
Verified InterPro family accession for NAD(P)HX repair proteins (IPR023691 used as candidate; may need to be updated to IPR004794 or equivalent).

MMseqs2-formatted target database path is unavailable; the non-redundant clustering step (mmseqs2_gpu) is therefore omitted — provide a local database path to enable sequence-similarity-based representative selection in a follow-up plan.

success_criteria.dehydratase_sequences_retrieved: go_sequences returns at least 1 reviewed sequence for GO:0102298
success_criteria.epimerase_sequences_retrieved: go_sequences returns at least 1 reviewed sequence for GO:0102299
success_criteria.interpro_sequences_retrieved: interpro_sequences returns at least 1 reviewed sequence for IPR023691
success_criteria.analyses_complete: sequence_analysis produces composition, charge, and motif records for all three retrieval sets
success_criteria.ranking_produced: rank_designs returns a ranked list of up to top_k=10 representative NAD(P)HX repair sequence candidates with aggregate scores
